name: Basketball: Zero

redeem: Like Basketball: Zero on its Roblox page and join the Current. Roblox group, or every code will be rejected.
Launch the game and wait until you are in the main lobby.
Click the purple Codes gift icon at the right end of the menu bar along the bottom of the screen.
Type the code into the Enter Code box and press Redeem to get your spins and Money.
notes:
Basketball: Zero is a fast 5v5 basketball game from the Current. group, inspired by the anime Kuroko's Basketball and once called Basketball Rivals. You pick a style with its own abilities, then shoot, pass, dribble, and dunk while building up your zone for a strong boost. Matches are short, and the style and zone you own shape a lot of how you play.

Codes give Lucky Style Spins, Lucky Zone Spins, and Money. The lucky spins are the best part since they give better odds at rare styles and zones, which matter more than cash. New codes come with updates, character birthdays, and events, and they are posted in the official Discord and by the developer Chrollo. Codes that start with 15 only work after 15 minutes of play.

faq.q: Why does Basketball: Zero say MUST LIKE THE GAME & JOIN THE GROUP?
faq.a: Codes only work after you like the game on Roblox and join the Current. group. Do both, rejoin the game, and redeem the code again.
Codes that start with 15 unlock after you have played for 15 minutes. Stay in the game for a while, then try the code again.
No. The game accepts codes in upper or lower case, so only the letters and numbers need to be right.

tips: Hold left click to shoot and tap it for a pump fake. A quick fake can get a defender to jump, giving you room to drive past.
Use spacebar for layups and dunks when you get close to the hoop. Shots near the rim are usually safer than long jumpers.
Right click passes and Q dribbles. Moving the ball with quick passes is often faster than dribbling through a whole defense.
Each style has its own abilities, so learn what yours does in a few matches before deciding whether to roll for a different one.

Hold on to the Money until you know what you want to spend it on.
